integrity: The complete proof and an independently runnable symbolic check are included; no external independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ideal exact-arithmetic Krylov backward-error minimum for nonzero real symmetric PSD matrices; an inconsistent three-dimensional singular example attains the constant, with SPD approach only in a limit. Does not establish finite-precision behavior or later-step constants. Earlier scalar rational-approximation literature is a residual priority risk.
title: The sharp universal second-subspace backward-error factor for MINBERR
